prediction.question: 次は少女が何をするか？
options: 少女は蒸気機関に乗り込む
少女は記憶を取り戻す手紙を読む
少女は自らの記憶を消し去る

en.title: The Etched Steam Archive
en.premise: In a city overrun by sorcerers who wield supernatural powers at the cost of their own memories, the protagonist runs a second-hand bookstore that buys and sells "forgotten memories." His quiet life is upended when he encounters a girl who should have been erased from existence and a "Blank Forbidden Book" devoid of any text. Upon discovering that the colossal steam engine sustaining the city is actually a memory-erasing device fueled by the despair of its citizens, he plunges into a brutal struggle to fill the empty pages of the forbidden book.

zh.title: 蝕刻的蒸氣書庫
zh.premise: 在術師們以記憶為代價揮舞異能的城市中，主角經營著一家收購「被遺忘記憶」的古書店。某日，他遇見了一名本應連同存在一起被抹除的少女，以及一本沒有任何記載的「空白禁書」。當他得知維持都市運作的巨大蒸氣機關，其實是以市民的絕望為燃料的記憶抹除裝置後，他為了填滿禁書的頁面，投身於一場殘酷的戰鬥之中。
